g.text: The chariot: fill to 30 kg, empty, fill again
Real run of ConvoyeurDemo: 5 loaders, 5 unloaders, Chariot(30 kg, 10 items). Stock: 5 4 1 2 6 8 10 8 7 10
charger(): poid + 10 > 30, so setFull() and throw
loader puts it back in the stock
setFull() wakes 'full'; oldest item leaves first
The whole run, trip by trip (red dashed line = 30 kg)
stock empty: last loader calls setFull()
